correctness.rationale: For the exact hexagonal norm, the source's Proposition 5.8 gives Omega'=(9/10)gamma_X(1/3), reconstructed algebraically from u=(x+y)/2, v=(x-y)/2 and conversely. Squared norms are convex; maximizing the two-variable objective on the product of the two unit balls reduces exactly to their 6x6 vertex pairs. Independently computed all 36 rational pairs: only 10/9 and 25/18 appear; maximum 25/18, giving 5/4. Direct isosceles witness u=(1,1/2), v=(0,1/2) has N(u±v)=1, N(u+2v)=3/2, N(2u+v)=2, hence quotient 5/4. This convexity argument makes the finite enumeration exhaustive rather than experimental.
